evidence.description: A black BMW X5 was allegedly stolen from a Sammamish home
The BMW was found in the parking lot of a Seattle motel where the defendant had reportedly been staying

notes: KIRO 7 gives no date for this incident. The date 30 Dec 2024 comes from a Herald search excerpt, and that page was not read, so the date is unconfirmed. The same excerpt calls this the first link between the suspect and the series; that is also unconfirmed. The series is described in KIRO 7 as burglaries between November 2024 and February 2025 across Seattle, Medina, Sammamish and Everett.
